title: Grant admin role to current account and fix access denied

requirements.summary: Remove the access denied state from AdminGuard component by ensuring the isAdmin check passes for the current user
acceptanceCriteria: AdminGuard component allows access to admin dashboard
No 'Access Denied' screen is shown for the current user

file_operations.description: Update AdminGuard component to properly handle admin access verification. Ensure the component correctly checks authentication status and admin privileges using the useIsAdmin hook. Verify that loading states are handled before showing access denied, and that the component renders children when admin access is confirmed. Review the conditional rendering logic to prevent premature access denial during authentication initialization.

Review and update the useIsAdmin hook to ensure it properly fetches admin status from the backend actor. Verify that the hook correctly handles the actor availability check, includes proper error handling, and returns accurate loading/fetching states. Ensure the query is enabled only when the actor is ready and that it properly invalidates when authentication state changes.
